reason: The text fragment (Exodus 1:6-12) does not depict Yahweh at all. Since Yahweh is not mentioned or characterized in this passage, the statement about how Yahweh is depicted cannot apply. The text focuses exclusively on human actors (Joseph, the Egyptians, the Israelites) and human actions.
